Good luck anyway!

messages.author: 42eed4e1caba0ad0
messages.subject: Re: Upload excel file and use it
parts:
Hi Yoni,

  1. RApache handles file upload through FILES superglobal. Read the manual! If you're interested in importing the XLS file to R, try RODBC or gdata packages. Gergely already provided a link.
  2. See ?gdata::read.xls (read the manual!)
    "read.xls" returns a data frame.
  3. photo output? Did you mean graph/plot?
Uploading files is an easy one. Session management is the tricky part. But you should cover the basics first.

Best,
Alex
